newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT sees "split" decision by end-97.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT sees "split" decision by end-97.

text.p: Dutch PTT Nederland NV said on Wednesday the merger of the Unisource partners' international telecoms networks had no bearing on its decision of whether or not to separately list its telecoms and postal arms.
"It hasn't got any influence on that. This is a very separate process," KPN spokesman Ernst Moeksis told Reuters.
Unisource announced earlier that the partners, KPN's Dutch unit PTT Telecom, Telia of Sweden and Swiss Telecom PTT, had agreed to the merger.
He said KPN still planned to make a decision on separate listings before the end of this year.
Analysts and media commentators have been speculating that KPN might bring forward its decision to split the company.
